# Bugherd

BugHerd is a visual feedback and bug tracking tool for websites, allowing clients and teams to report issues directly on live sites.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bugherd/.

## Actions

- **Add Guest to Project**: Add a guest (client) to a project.
- **Add Member to Project**: Add a member to a project in bugherd.
- **Create Attachment**: Add a new attachment to a task using an existing url.
- **Create Comment**: Add a new comment to a task.
- **Create Project**: Create a new project.
- **Create Task**: Add a new task in a project.
- **Create Webhook**: Create a new webhook for real-time event notifications.
- **Delete Project**: Delete a project.
- **List Active Projects** (read-only): List all active projects in your bugherd account.
- **List Attachments** (read-only): List all attachments for a task.
- **List Projects** (read-only): List all projects in your account.
- **List Users** (read-only): List all users in your account.
- **List Webhooks** (read-only): List all installed webhooks.
- **Show Attachment** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific attachment.
- **Show Project** (read-only): Show details for a specific project.
- **Show User Projects** (read-only): List all projects a specific user has access to.
- **Show User Tasks** (read-only): List tasks created or assigned to a specific user.
- **Update Project**: Update settings for an existing project.
- **Update Task**: Update a task in a project.
- **Create Column**: Create a new column in a project.
- **List Columns** (read-only): List all columns for a project.
- **Show Column** (read-only): Show details of a specific column.
- **Show Organization** (read-only): Retrieve your bugherd organization details.
- **Update Column**: Update a column in a project.
- **Upload Attachment**: Upload a new attachment and add it to a specific task.
